Top Attractions

Stone Town

UNESCO World Heritage site with historic architecture, bustling markets, and cultural tours.

Learn more

Nungwi Beach

White‑sand beach on the northern tip of Zanzibar, perfect for sunbathing, snorkeling, and sunset cruises.

Learn more

Jozani Forest

Home to the rare Red Colobus monkey and guided eco‑tours through mangrove and forest trails.

Learn more

Prison Island

Historical prison turned marine reserve, famous for giant tortoises and snorkeling spots.

Learn more

Spice Farm

Explore Zanzibar’s spice heritage with guided tours of clove, cinnamon, and nutmeg plantations.

Learn more
